settings.name: sync
settings.label: Sync products
settings.help: Loads the Shopify frontpage collection, creates missing CMS products, and fully refreshes products that changed on Shopify. Status: new/stale → updated; when already in sync, refresh counts idle maintenance (one oldest-checked product per click). Stops after about 50 seconds if there is a large queue.

settings.name: sync_orders
settings.label: Sync orders
settings.help: Pulls Shopify onto CMS carts and orders: attach missing order ids, refresh payment and per-line fulfilment, then queue CMS fulfilment for still-unfulfilled paid lines. Stops after about 50 seconds — click again to continue. Same job as the Shopify order sync repeating task.

settings.name: purge
settings.label: Purge products
settings.help: Deletes local products missing on Shopify, and older local duplicates of the same Shopify ID (keeps the newest panel). Related images removed. Oldest first. Stops after about 50 seconds — click Purge again to continue.

settings.name: purge_images
settings.label: Purge images
settings.help: Moves unused Shopify-scraped images (and their resized copies) to cache/tmp/img/, preserving paths. Stops after about 100 seconds — click again to continue.

settings.name: reload_data
settings.label: Reload Shopify data
settings.help: Marks every local product for a full Shopify refresh (sync_needed). Does not call Shopify immediately — run Sync to process the queue. Products not yet refreshed keep serving cached CMS / thumbnail HTML.

settings.name: shopify_data_ttl
settings.label: Shopify data recheck (seconds)
settings.help: How long CMS product data is treated as fresh without a full Shopify Admin recheck on the product page (default 86400 = 1 day). Grids never call Shopify.

settings.name: product_page_recheck_ttl
settings.label: Product page recheck (seconds)
settings.help: How often a product page may recheck Shopify for price/availability (default 300 = 5 minutes)

settings.name: max_refresh_time
settings.label: Max refresh time per request (seconds)
settings.help: Budget for Shopify Admin API product refreshes in one page request (default 30). When exhausted, serve CMS data without more live API calls

settings.name: collection_subcategory_suffix
settings.label: Subcategory suffix
settings.help: Shopify titles ending with this become shop/subcategory. This match runs before collection types. Example: suffix {category} → {Birthday Category} → subcategory Birthday. Matching is case-insensitive; suffix is stripped from the heading.

settings.name: collections
settings.label: Collection suffixes
settings.help: Shopify titles ending with the collection type heading become shop/collection of that type. Example: type heading {group} → {Birthday Group} → collection Birthday. Do not use the same word as Subcategory suffix (that match wins).

settings.name: category_maps
settings.label: Shopify category map
settings.help: Match text found in Shopify Standard Product Category path (e.g. Artwork, Cards) to a shop category. Used for subcategory parent and for "Other art" / "Other cards" when no range collection.
